name: Peek Park
hook: Table shows only colour dabs; your magnifier reveals people turned to face you.

name: Fizzwick's Lab
hook: Pour one beaker into another by twisting; 25 discoveries, chains, Professor requests.

name: Night Lights
hook: Turn lanterns to sweep beams; shy owls need two beams crossing.
note: Firefly (carry fireflies to a jar) and Deep Sea (creatures flee bright light) are skins + one verb each.

name: Spirit Board
hook: The pointer only glides when every player's finger is on or around it; a kind, funny AI spirit answers.
needs: Claude at runtime (or a big pre-written answer bank offline)

name: Kitchen Rush (and Slow Kitchen)
hook: Everyone reaching across one kitchen; pans and pots are pieces; slow mode has no timers.

name: Prism Heist
hook: Turn mirror pieces to bend a laser around guards to the vault — rotation as a precise aiming dial.
note: Physical mirrors aren't needed (the screen can't see them); the printed turret just shows the mirror face.

name: Story Together
hook: Each kid secretly places their character on a choice; the blend steers the story; saved as a picture book.

name: Campground Caper
hook: Hand on your piece = moving and visible; let go to freeze in disguise.

name: Teddy Clinic
hook: Printed stethoscope, thermometer and bandage pieces used on patients on the table; every patient gets better.

name: Dino Dig
hook: Sweep a brush piece back and forth to scrape away dirt and uncover a fossil (scratch-off reveal).
note: A 'scrub' variant of reveal — great TK game.

name: Pretend Island
hook: Your printed doll lives on the table; rooms and friends react; the island is saved between nights.

name: Wagon Trail
src: G Merchant Galleons of the Spice Coast
hook: A trail map across the table; push the wagon piece; turn it to set pace; vote on river crossings.

name: Bloom
hook: Place, turn and hold tool pieces (sun, cloud, seed pot, mountain) and watch a barren world bloom; time-lapse at the end.

name: Main Street Together
hook: Each kid runs a shop on a shared street; hold a piece on your shop to upgrade; shops supply each other.

name: Rummi Tiles
hook: The big shared table makes rearranging melds easy and rule-checked; racks stay private on phones.

name: Mexican Train
hook: Gorgeous trains snake out from the station; your train engine piece marks your line; hands on phones.

name: Liar's Dice & Poker Night
hook: Secrets on phones; slide your chip piece in to bet, turn it to set the bid; dramatic reveal on the table.

name: Bomb Squad
hook: The bomb is on the table; only one phone has the manual — shout instructions across the table.

name: Island Builders (Catan-style)
hook: A new beautiful island every game; trading stays face-to-face; a printed raccoon robber.

name: Dream Mahjong
hook: Tile art the family designs (AI-generated suits: our pets, our town); the table checks hands.
note: Rules complexity makes this a parents-first game; a simplified kids' variant helps.

name: Pet Parade
hook: A physical step-sequencer: position is time, rotation is pitch; record your own voices as instruments.

name: Sleepy Farm Roundup
hook: Slide barn pieces over wandering sheep before the (silly) wolves arrive at sunset.

name: Chameleon Swat
hook: 60-second chaos rounds with pieces as swatters and bumpers; the littlest gets bigger targets.
note: Don't flick physical pieces across the glass (scratches, lost tracking) — pieces push virtual pucks.

name: Treasure Tides
hook: A spyglass piece shows clues only in the direction it faces; a shovel piece digs.

name: Gone Fishin'
hook: Spin your reel piece round and round to reel in a fish (rotation as a crank).
note: A printed thumb-crank can't be sensed — spinning the whole piece can.

name: Slime Outbreak
hook: Green goo spreads across a town; place wall pieces to contain it together.

name: Castle Siege
hook: Turn your trebuchet to aim; walls cast protective shadows.

name: Tadpole Crossing
hook: Drop lily pads to calm the current so frogs can cross.

name: Constellation Maker
hook: Connect stars with pieces to draw constellations and reveal their animated myths.

name: Circuit City
hook: Place gate pieces to route power/water/gears to light up the city.
note: Physical gears can't mesh-detect; turning one gear piece drives digital gears.

name: Wizard Duel
hook: Combine rune pieces into spells that collide mid-table (Fizz Lab's mix verb, versus).

name: Submarine Sonar
hook: Your sub's true position is secret on your phone; the table shows only sonar pings.
note: Hidden movement conflicts with physical pieces on the table, so positions live on phones.

name: Crypt Crawl
src: G Fog of War: Trench Line
hook: Grid tactics with printed minis; the table tracks health, spells and line of sight.

name: Word Garden
hook: Put prefix and root pieces side by side to grow words (adjacency, not stacking).

name: Space Mining Co.
hook: Lower priority: heavier strategy or older-teen themes that fit the family less well.
